platform: CHLY 101.7FM Nanaimo Music Submission Form, Email Fallback and Physical Route
manual_review_reason: CHLY requires human review because it rejects AI-generated music, requires downloadable high-quality 320 kbps MP3 or AAC rather than streaming-only delivery, asks for biography, focus tracks, explicit-language flags, genre/subgenre and accurate optional local, CanCon and content labels, and gives form-completed submissions priority. The live embedded form fields and runtime validation or CAPTCHA controls were not fully exposed in passive HTML. A human must confirm production origin, rights, release type, files, links, metadata and labels, inspect the current form and submit manually. submissions@chly.ca may be used only when the form does not work, and music@chly.ca is for assistance rather than bypassing the form.

platform: CIVL Radio 101.7FM Abbotsford Music Director Email and CAPTCHA Contact Form
manual_review_reason: CIVL publishes music@civl.ca for the Music Director and provides a first-party contact form whose subject menu includes Submit your music. The form explicitly contains CAPTCHA, and the page does not publish complete audio-format, attachment, link, release-window, rights or response rules. A human must review current requirements, choose the submission subject, supply only permitted links, files and personal data, complete CAPTCHA, confirm rights and track fit, and send manually. The CAPTCHA or any other validation must not be automated or bypassed.
